name: Same-line compact phrase branch on the consumed third RoadTextVQA panel
question: Can one box-layout branch recover split multi-token target names without changing the sealed background-IDF token branch?
observed_before_freeze: The sealed goal-conditioned result retained eleven UNKNOWN rows.
Several have split or punctuated aliases, including red ribbon run, u-haul, t seva, high end, and one east river place.
The official OCR JSON retains quadrilateral word boxes that the token-only verifier did not use.

layout_phrase_contract.rule: Within one sampled frame, concatenate two to four normalized OCR tokens only when their boxes form a left-to-right chain with at least 50% vertical overlap and no gap greater than three times local text height. Compare to the complete compact alias; length at most five is exact-only and longer aliases permit one edit.

execution_rule: Run exactly once on the consumed panel. Do not tune layout thresholds or alias matching after observing the result; any authority increase requires a separate fresh OCR-unseen panel.

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed posthoc mechanism evidence for using OCR box layout to rejoin split target-name phrases.
not_allowed: fresh, blind, independent, provider-disjoint, target-absent specificity, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, deployment, benefit, reliability, or safety confirmation
a same-line phrase proving sign-to-entity, facade, portal, or entrance ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, or handoff
